# Awesome MCP Servers

> Hand-curated, link-checked catalog of 240 Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in 13 categories. Each entry has a URL, description, category, language, provider, tags, and an official flag. The interactive map, JSON API, and these files are generated from the same data.

MCP is an open protocol that lets AI applications connect to external tools and data through a standardized client-server interface. This catalog lists well-scoped, source-available servers for databases, developer tools, browsers, cloud services, and more. Entries are reviewed for a clear purpose, a public source, and recent or official maintenance. Links are checked on every pull request and weekly.

Links under each category point at the upstream project, docs, or registry page. Use the Data section for the complete Markdown catalog and the JSON API. The Optional section is background an agent can skip.

## Data

- [Full catalog](https://landscape.mcphq.org/llms-full.txt): Every server in Markdown, with language, provider, tags, official status, and remote endpoints when listed.
- [Servers JSON](https://landscape.mcphq.org/api/servers.json): The same catalog as a JSON array.
- [Categories JSON](https://landscape.mcphq.org/api/categories.json): Category ids, names, and descriptions.
- [Server schema](https://github.com/mcpHQ/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/data/servers.schema.json): Allowed fields for each catalog entry.

## Official and Reference Servers

- [MCP Everything](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/everything): Reference server exposing prompts, resources, and tools for protocol testing. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Fetch](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/fetch): Fetch web content and convert HTML to markdown for LLM consumption. (Python, official)
- [MCP Filesystem](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/filesystem): Secure local filesystem access with configurable allowed directories. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Git](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/git): Read, search, and manipulate Git repositories through MCP tools. (Python, official)
- [MCP Inspector](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector): Visual testing tool for debugging MCP server capabilities and messages. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Memory](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/memory): Knowledge graph memory for persistent entities and relationships. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Python SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk): Official Python SDK for building MCP servers and clients. (Python, official)
- [MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry): Official MCP registry service and API for discovering publicly available MCP servers. (Go, official)
- [MCP Sequential Thinking](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/sequentialthinking): Structured step-by-step reasoning tool for complex problem solving. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Time](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/time): Time and timezone conversion utilities for agents and assistants. (Python, official)
- [MCP TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk): Official TypeScript SDK for building MCP servers and clients. (TypeScript, official)

- [MotherDuck MCP Server](https://github.com/motherduckdb/mcp-server-motherduck): Run analytical SQL queries against local DuckDB files and MotherDuck cloud databases. (Python, official)
- [Neon MCP Server](https://github.com/neondatabase/mcp-server-neon): Manage Neon Postgres databases, branches, and SQL queries via MCP. (TypeScript, official)
- [Pinecone MCP Server](https://github.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-mcp): Manage Pinecone indexes and run semantic vector queries. (TypeScript, official)
- [PlanetScale MCP Server](https://planetscale.com/docs/connect/mcp): Manage PlanetScale MySQL databases, branches, and schema changes. (TypeScript, official)
- [Prisma MCP Server](https://www.prisma.io/docs/ai/tools/mcp-server): Manage Prisma Postgres databases, Prisma Compute deployments, and Object Storage from AI tools through a remote MCP server. (Other, official)
- [Qdrant MCP Server](https://github.com/qdrant/mcp-server-qdrant): Store and retrieve vectors in Qdrant for RAG workflows. (Python, official)
- [Redis MCP Server](https://github.com/redis/mcp-redis): Read and write Redis keys, lists, and data structures through MCP. (Python, official)

- [Supabase MCP Server](https://github.com/supabase-community/supabase-mcp): Community-maintained integration for Supabase projects, tables, and auth through MCP tools. (TypeScript)

- [IntlPull MCP Server](https://intlpull.com/docs/mcp): Manage translation keys, translate strings, and sync localization files with IntlPull from MCP clients. (TypeScript, official)
- [Kleap](https://github.com/kleaphq/cli): Create, edit, and publish websites from AI clients through a hosted MCP server. (JavaScript, official)
- [Kubernetes MCP Server](https://github.com/Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes): Operate Kubernetes clusters with kubectl-style MCP tools. (TypeScript)
- [Linear MCP Server](https://linear.app/docs/mcp): Create and manage Linear issues, projects, and team workflows. (TypeScript, official)
- [mcp-pool](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus/mcp-pool): MCP Key Pool Proxy — pool multiple API keys across upstream MCP servers to distribute rate limits. One subprocess per pool, lazy failover, per-key cooldown. (TypeScript)
- [NAIF Gravity](https://naifgravity.com): Hosted MCP diagnostics for API authentication, webhooks, and AI-agent integration failures, with bounded repair workflows based on sanitized evidence; free triage and optional paid repairs. (Other, official)

(TypeScript, official)
- [SigRank MCP](https://github.com/SunrisesIllNeverSee/sigrank-mcp): AI operator token-efficiency leaderboard + yield cascade metrics. 15 tools for agents to measure, rank, and improve token usage. (JavaScript)
- [VideoGen MCP](https://videogen.io/videogen-mcp): Official VideoGen server for creating and editing videos, images, voiceovers, music, and avatars, then remixing and exporting projects. (TypeScript, official)
- [Zep MCP Server](https://github.com/jaysack/zep-mcp): Community MCP wrapper for long-term memory and context retrieval with Zep. (Python)

## Data, Analytics, and BI

- [Amplitude MCP Server](https://amplitude.com/docs/amplitude-ai/amplitude-mcp): Analyze product analytics events and user behavior in Amplitude. (TypeScript, official)
- [Basedash MCP Server](https://github.com/Basedash/mcp): Governed BI MCP. Ask questions of live company data and list workspace sources via OAuth. (Other)
- [BOIM (보임)](https://github.com/kikiyop1101/boim-mcp): Hosted read-only MCP server for finding Korean businesses (2.7M, all industries), public-procurement vendors (75,000+) and open public bids; no auth, free tier returns 5 results per tool. (Other, official)
- [Bruin Cloud MCP](https://getbruin.com/docs/bruin/cloud/mcp-setup.html): Hosted MCP server for Bruin Cloud to list data pipelines, inspect runs, and trigger actions from Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex via OAuth or an access token. (Other, official)
- [Bruin MCP](https://getbruin.com/docs/bruin/getting-started/bruin-mcp.html): Local MCP server in the open-source Bruin CLI that lets agents query databases, ingest data, compare tables, and build SQL and Python data pipelines. (Go, official)
- [CompanyProof](https://companyproof.ai/docs/mcp): Hosted company search, registry profiles and verification of six company identity fields with source evidence, OAuth or API key access, and shared account credits. (Other, official)
- [Datadog MCP Server](https://github.com/datadog-labs/mcp-server): Query metrics, logs, and monitors from Datadog via the official Datadog Labs MCP server. (Python, official)
- [dbt MCP Server](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-mcp): Run dbt models, tests, and documentation workflows via MCP. (Python, official)
- [DC Hub](https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server): Hosted MCP server and live data layer for data-center site selection: mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets, daily DCPI scores for 300+ markets and live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs; free tier needs no key. (JavaScript, official)
- [Global Database](https://api.globaldatabase.com/docs/v2/#mcp-server): Hosted MCP server for company profiles, financials, ownership, officers, business contacts and KYB checks, with browser-based OAuth authentication. (Other, official)
- [Google GenAI Toolbox](https://github.com/googleapis/genai-toolbox): Connect agents to BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Spanner, and other Google data sources. (Go, official)
- [Grafana MCP Server](https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana): Explore Grafana dashboards, alerts, and observability data. (Go, official)
- [LLM Pulse MCP Server](https://github.com/LLM-Pulse/llmpulse-mcp): Analyze AI search visibility, citations, sentiment, share of voice, and AI traffic. (JavaScript)
- [LogNorm](https://github.com/lognorm/lognorm-mcp): Hosted MCP server that hands a site's SEO/GEO growth backlog (audits, fixes, content, AI-visibility tracking) to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor via OAuth. (Other, official)
- [MadeOnSol MCP Server](https://github.com/MadeOnSol/mcp-server-madeonsol): Solana KOL trades, wallet analytics, token and deployer intelligence, and DEX data via an API key or keyless x402 pay-per-call in USDC. (TypeScript, official)
- [Manifold MCP](https://www.manifoldmcp.com): An MCP for marketers that gives agents tools for SEO, AEO, socials and ads data, from keywords, backlinks and Search Console to AI answer visibility, ad libraries and social platforms, with a generous free tier. (Other, official)
- [Metabase MCP Server](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/ai/mcp): Query dashboards and explore data in Metabase BI. (TypeScript, official)
- [Mixpanel MCP Server](https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/mcp): Query Mixpanel funnels, retention, and event analytics. (TypeScript, official)
- [Netdata MCP Server](https://github.com/netdata/netdata): Real-time infrastructure monitoring and health metrics via MCP. (C, official)
- [Robot Speed](https://github.com/robot-speed/mcp): SEO tools for AI agents: audits, Core Web Vitals, keywords, AI visibility, traffic, backlinks, and CMS publishing. (TypeScript, official)
- [Screpy SEO MCP](https://screpy.com/feature/seo-mcp/): Hosted SEO MCP for project-scoped crawl, rank tracking, stored AI visibility, Core Web Vitals, and uptime data via OAuth. (Other, official)

## Legal and Court Data

- [Court Rules MCP](https://github.com/foklepoint/court-rules-mcp): Read U.S. federal and state court filing rules, local rules, judge standing orders, and court holiday calendars, with a citation back to the source document. (Other)
- [eCFR MCP](https://github.com/lrehmann/ecfr-mcp): Search and read U.S. federal regulations with legal citations, source dates, stale-data flags, and paginated text; an independent eCFR mirror, not the official legal edition. (TypeScript)
- [eCourts India MCP](https://mcp.ecourtsindia.com/): Third-party hosted MCP for Indian court data, including Supreme Court, High Courts, district courts, and tribunals. (Other)
- [US Code MCP](https://github.com/lrehmann/uscode-mcp): Read-only U.S. Code search, section retrieval, and title browsing with citations linked to uscode.ecfr.io and published OLRC release metadata; independent OLRC corpus mirror, not a government service. (TypeScript)

## Security and Identity

- [1Password MCP Server](https://github.com/CakeRepository/1Password-MCP): Community-maintained integration for accessing 1Password vault items in agent workflows. (Go)
- [AcqPath](https://github.com/reflectme-source/acqpath-distribution): Signed, timestamped observations of machine-readable source-rights declarations for RAG, indexing, training, search, and AI input workflows. (Other, official)
- [Auth0 MCP Server](https://github.com/auth0/auth0-mcp-server): Manage Auth0 tenants, applications, and user identity settings. (TypeScript, official)
- [CrowdStrike MCP Server](https://github.com/CrowdStrike/falcon-mcp): Query CrowdStrike Falcon detections and endpoint security data. (Python, official)
- [Darkmoon MCP Server](https://github.com/ASCIT31/darkmoon-mcp-server): Start autonomous AI pentest runs, poll status, list campaigns and read findings on a self-hosted Darkmoon Pro instance over stdio. (TypeScript, official)
- [FractalAI Agent Passport](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fractalai/agent-passport-mcp): Verifies ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) signed agent receipts offline and exposes pay-per-call x402 tools (USDC on Base) that return post-quantum signed receipts. (TypeScript, official)
- [HANRIA Mandate Check](https://hanria.ai): Free, advisory pre-action check: check_action returns permit, deny or escalate for a proposed agent action against a mandate, with the governing clause and an Ed25519-signed receipt, and validate_mandate checks a mandate for errors. (JavaScript, official)
- [Lodestar Stamp](https://lodestarstamp.com): Agent trust layer: a dated receipt on a named entity. REST lookup plus MCP discovery card. We attest; we do not approve the booking. (TypeScript)
- [Scalekit MCP Server](https://github.com/scalekit-inc/scalekit-mcp-server): Manage Scalekit organizations, users, SSO connections, and MCP OAuth from an official hosted server. (TypeScript, official)
- [Snyk MCP Server](https://github.com/snyk/studio-mcp): Scan dependencies and code for vulnerabilities with Snyk. (TypeScript, official)
- [Tanod](https://tanod.dev): Solidity contract scans, pre-transaction address risk checks, OFAC SDN address screening and MCP server/skill package scans for agents, plus web, DNS and chain reads. Free daily tier, then pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base). (Python, official)
- [Vault MCP Server](https://github.com/hashicorp/vault-mcp-server): Read secrets and manage HashiCorp Vault policies via MCP. (Go, official)
- [Wiz MCP Server](https://www.wiz.io/blog/introducing-mcp-server-for-wiz): Cloud security posture management and risk insights from Wiz. (TypeScript, official)

## Finance, Commerce, and Business Apps

- [ADEXTO](https://github.com/0xcuy/adexto): Bonding-curve token markets on Monad, Arbitrum One, Base, Robinhood Chain and 0G: list and price markets, buy with USDC on Base over x402, and prepare launch, stake and claim transactions for your own key. (TypeScript, official)
- [AdsTurbo](https://adsturbo.ai): Create ecommerce video ads and product images: clone a reference ad around a product, AI actor videos, text/image-to-video, lip sync and video translation, over remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 or an API key. (Other, official)
- [AgentServices](https://github.com/vbkotecha/agentservices-api): Paid API platform for AI agents — crypto prices, DeFi yields, market indicators, dispute resolution, and on-chain analytics via x402 micropayments. (Python)
- [agpay](https://agpay.shveik.dev): Payments held between two agents: the buyer pays by x402 or MPP, the seller proves its wallet and delivers, the buyer confirms and the seller is paid; disputes are decided by hand. Paid in stablecoins, no account. (Go, official)
- [Astral Twin](https://astraldaily.com): Create and mint NFT asset packs on the Base blockchain from AI clients. (Other, official)
- [BankBridge](https://bankbridge.money): Hosted MCP server that gives an agent read-only access to your own bank, credit card, and brokerage accounts: balances, transactions, spending summaries, recurring charges, cashflow, and investment holdings. (TypeScript, official)
- [Bilbop x402](https://github.com/bilbop1/bilbop-x402-mcp): Pay-per-call agent tools paid in USDC on Solana over x402, no account or API key: text summarize, Solana token brief and mint info, text-to-speech, and human brand feedback. (JavaScript, official)
- [BuyWhere MCP](https://github.com/BuyWhere/buywhere-mcp): Hosted product-search MCP server for multi-merchant price comparison across Singapore, SEA, and US catalogs. (TypeScript, official)
- [canli-validation-mcp](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-validation-mcp): Checks whether a backtest result is real or just the luckiest of the variants tried: deflated Sharpe ratio, CSCV overfitting probability, data-snooping tests, lookahead checks and pipeline placebos. (JavaScript, official)
- [Clera](https://github.com/getclera/mcp): Search 210,000+ vetted startup candidates, review Clera's picks for your open roles, and request intros through a hosted OAuth MCP server. (TypeScript, official)
- [Datacircle](https://docs.datacircle.dev/mcp-server): Datacircle is a data co-op. Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 or an API key. (Python, official)
- [Equibles](https://equibles.com/mcp): Hosted MCP server for US company fundamentals as reported in SEC filings, filing text, earnings-call transcripts, 13F holdings and insider trades, with OAuth or API-key access. (C#, official)
- [Fincept MCP](https://github.com/Fincept-Corporation/fincept-mcp-docs): Hosted MCP server for Fincept Terminal: quotes, candles, option chains, fundamentals, economic data, SEC filings, news, backtests, paper trading and 15 quant engines, with OAuth sign-in. (Other, official)
- [FirstSales MCP](https://developer.firstsales.io/agents/mcp-server): Retrieve CRM contacts, deals, lists and workflows, and create contacts in approved workspaces via hosted OAuth MCP; requires an eligible paid FirstSales plan. (TypeScript, official)
- [Glongus MCP](https://github.com/glongusmain/glongus-mcp): Lets an agent buy and sell physical goods on the Glongus UK marketplace, with haggling, escrow, shipping and seller reputation. (JavaScript, official)
- [HubSpot MCP Server](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/integrate-with-the-remote-hubspot-mcp-server): Access HubSpot contacts, deals, and marketing automation data. (TypeScript, official)
- [Invompt](https://mcp.invompt.com/mcp): Turn AI-host work into invoices you review before send — Continue as guest or OAuth via hosted MCP. Site https://www.invompt.com (TypeScript, official)
- [Live Tennis API MCP](https://github.com/livetennisapi/livetennisapi-mcp): Real-time tennis match state — score, current server, three-valued break-point flag, and retirement/walkover/completed status — plus players, rankings, Elo, and fixtures across ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF, and juniors. (TypeScript)
- [MAQAMI Travel](https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server): Search hotels (3M+) and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co for the chosen offer; payment is taken only there. Hosted, no API key. (JavaScript, official)
- [NotFair](https://github.com/nowork-studio/NotFair): Open-source Claude Code agent skills for SEO, GEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads, connecting to live data via Google Ads MCP, Meta Ads MCP, Google Search Console MCP, and Google Analytics (GA4) MCP. (TypeScript)
- [PayPal MCP Server](https://github.com/paypal/agent-toolkit): Process PayPal payments and manage merchant operations. (TypeScript, official)

- [Pocket Drives](https://github.com/RevList/pocket-drives-mcp): Search, quote, and browse luxury, exotic, and EV rentals from independent hosts. Location autocomplete, availability, and airport/venue delivery. Booking finishes in the iOS app. (TypeScript)
- [QuickBooks MCP Server](https://github.com/intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server): Manage QuickBooks accounting records and financial reports. (TypeScript, official)
- [Salesforce MCP Server](https://github.com/salesforcecli/mcp): Query Salesforce CRM records and manage business workflows. (TypeScript, official)
- [Shopify MCP Server](https://github.com/GeLi2001/shopify-mcp): Community-maintained integration for Shopify products, orders, and store operations. (TypeScript)
- [SkyAccess](https://github.com/sky-access/skyaccess-mcp): Search 5,000+ live empty leg flights, get charter price estimates and booking links. No account or API key. (JavaScript, official)

- [Square MCP Server](https://github.com/square/square-mcp-server): Process Square payments and manage point-of-sale operations. (TypeScript, official)

- [Voidpay Marketplace MCP](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp): Find services and storefronts on Voidly's hosted marketplace for AI-agent services and prepare checkout links that the owner reviews and approves in their own browser; the connector never signs, pays or holds keys. (TypeScript, official)
- [Whimbrel MedTech Analyst](https://github.com/WhimbrelResearch/whimbrel-mcp): Research up-and-coming US medtech companies from NIH and NSF grants, federal contracts, FDA clearances and Breakthrough marketing authorizations; company research links every line to its source. (JavaScript, official)
- [Worklittle Jobs](https://github.com/worklittle/jobs-mcp): Remote job search MCP for exploring 4 million roles with visa, salary, and distance filters, swiping to apply, and saving roles to a Worklittle account via OAuth. (Other)

## Utilities and Examples

- [A2ASearch MCP](https://github.com/tadas-github/a2asearch-mcp): Search thousands of MCP servers, agents, and CLI tools by capability. (TypeScript)
- [Anyquery](https://github.com/julien040/anyquery): Query 40+ apps and databases with SQL from a single local binary. (Go)
- [CareClinic Health Tracker](https://github.com/tandemloop/careclinic_mcp): Track symptoms, mood, medications, and wellness patterns through a remote OAuth MCP server. (Other)
- [FastMCP](https://github.com/jlowin/fastmcp): Python framework for building MCP servers quickly with decorators. (Python)
- [Google Maps MCP Server](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived/tree/main/src/google-maps): Geocoding, directions, and place search via Google Maps. (Python)
- [MCP Server Starter](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/create-typescript-server): Official TypeScript scaffold for creating new MCP servers. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Server Templates](https://github.com/Data-Everything/mcp-server-templates): Unified MCP platform connecting many apps behind one interface. (TypeScript)
- [mcp-trellis](https://github.com/amir1824/mcp-trellis): Zero-dependency TypeScript library that ships an MCP handler and OAuth 2.1 authorization server in one package for Claude, Gemini, and Codex connectors. (TypeScript)
- [MCPJungle](https://github.com/duaraghav8/MCPJungle): Self-hosted MCP server registry for enterprise AI agent deployments. (Go)
- [MetaMCP](https://github.com/metatool-ai/metatool-app): Middleware MCP server that aggregates and manages multiple connections. (TypeScript)
- [QRX](https://qrx.codes/developers/mcp): Creates artistic, print-ready QR codes from a prompt and a link, checks that each one decodes before returning it, and serves it through a hosted qrx.to short link. (TypeScript, official)
- [TableJourney](https://github.com/lewismvaughan/tablejourney-mcp): Where to eat in 222 cities, signature dishes, and dates of the next edition of 1,480 food festivals, each place with the source it was checked against; hosted, no auth. (Python, official)
- [Weather MCP Server](https://github.com/isdaniel/mcp_weather_server): Fetch current weather and forecasts from public weather APIs. (Python)
